form.label: Sourcetype Thresholds
form.description: Add, change or delete the silence threshold of one sourcetype in one index (patterns allowed: index app_*, sourcetype cisco:*). Only the sourcetypes listed here are monitored at this level. Click a row of the lookup to load it into the form, then press Apply. A new rule is inserted before the first wildcard rule so it takes precedence over "*".

search.query: | inputlookup idxmon_st_thresholds | streamstats count as rn | eval new=0 | eventstats min(eval(if(like(index,"%*%") OR like(sourcetype,"%*%"),rn,null()))) as fw | append [| makeresults | eval index=$f_index|s$, sourcetype=$f_st|s$, threshold_minutes=$f_thr|s$, enabled=$f_enabled|s$, severity=$f_sev|s$, owner=$f_owner|s$, comment=$f_comment|s$, new=1 | fields - _time] | eval index=trim(index), sourcetype=trim(sourcetype), key=lower(index)."|".lower(sourcetype) | eventstats max(rn) as old_rn, max(new) as hasnew by key | eventstats max(fw) as fw_all | eval pos=case(new=0, rn, isnotnull(old_rn), old_rn, isnotnull(fw_all), fw_all-0.5, true(), 1000000) | where new=1 OR hasnew=0 | where NOT (new=1 AND "$f_action$"="delete") | where len(index)>0 AND len(sourcetype)>0 | sort 0 pos | fields index sourcetype threshold_minutes enabled severity owner comment | outputlookup idxmon_st_thresholds.csv

panel.title: Lookup idxmon_st_thresholds (rule order matters - click a row to edit it)
Current status of monitored sourcetypes (reload after a change)

search.query: | `idxmon_status_st` | sort sort_order, - minutes_since | table index sourcetype status silent_for last_indexed_str threshold_minutes severity owner comment | rename index as Index, sourcetype as Sourcetype, status as Status, silent_for as "Silent for", last_indexed_str as "Last indexed", threshold_minutes as "Threshold (min)", severity as Severity, owner as Owner, comment as Comment
